francorMaqueen: Blocks for the DFRobot Maqueen Plus V3/V2 robot.
francorMaqueen.drive: Drives the left and right wheel. Negative values drive backwards.
francorMaqueen.driveBoth: Drives both wheels at the same speed. Negative values drive backwards.
francorMaqueen.driveV2: Drives the left and right wheel (V2). Negative values drive backwards.
francorMaqueen.driveV2|param|left: speed of the left wheel in percent, eg: 50
francorMaqueen.driveV2|param|right: speed of the right wheel in percent, eg: 50
francorMaqueen.drive|param|left: speed of the left wheel in percent, eg: 50
francorMaqueen.drive|param|right: speed of the right wheel in percent, eg: 50
francorMaqueen.linePosition:
Where the line is: from -2 (far right) to 2 (far left), 0 = centered.
Positive = line on the left. 100 = no line seen.
francorMaqueen.seesLine: True if the line sensor sees the black line.
francorMaqueen.sensorRaw: Raw brightness value of a line sensor.
francorMaqueen.start:
Resets the Maqueen Plus V3 board and waits until it answers.
Shows a check mark when ready.
francorMaqueen.startV2:
Starts the Maqueen Plus V2 and waits until it answers.
Shows a check mark when ready.
